question.text: Assume GST at 18% applies on a combined base of Rs. 700 made up of brokerage and exchange charges. What is the total GST payable?

explanation.text: The Logic: Treating the Rs. 700 figure and the 18% rate as stem assumptions, GST = 18% of Rs. 700 = Rs. 126. The calculation is a straight rate-times-base arithmetic check. The Trap: Rs. 90 applies 18% to only a partial base. Rs. 36 uses a much smaller component. Rs. 700 confuses the base with the GST amount itself. Note: This item is presented as a self-contained arithmetic exercise. Confirm the applicable GST rate and which trading-cost components form the base from the current statutory and exchange notifications before using these numbers for live trades.
